It's Mothers Day and I wanted to get my Mom something sweet. I was in Kandivali East at a friends house when she reccomended me I try from Brownie Point as they have amazing collection in cakes and pastries.

Made my way there, huge collection. So many options to choose from.

I chose 5 pastries instead of 1 cake as I could choose different flavors.

Fresh Mango Pastry :

Fresh Fruit cakes are my families favorite and so I chose the Fresh Mango as its Mango Season. Fresh whipped cream, fresh cut mango slices on top and very very soft sponge cake. It was just heaven. I could see the twinkle in my mom's eyes when she had the first bite.

Swiss Truffle Pastry :

This one is my favorite. Swiss chocolate with choco chips too. Soft and fresh. I had it with my favorite coffee and loved thr bitter sweet combo.

Purple Velvet Pastry :

I got this one coz it looked so beautiful with white and purple colors. Fresh soft sponge cake and whipped cream, just amazing and melt in the mouth soft

Minion Popsicle :

This one I got for my sweet sister. Looks like a unicorn. It is a cake Popsicle with fondant on the outside and chocolate cake on the inside.

Choco Overload Brownie :

I had to get one of their brownies. Soft brownie, with loads of chocolate. Me and my sister fought for the last bite for this. Loved it.

They stayed fresh in the fridge even after 2 days. I am absolutely in love with the fresh fruit pastries. I think this will be my go to shop for my dessert needs.

Thank you Brownie point for making my mother happy on this Mother's Day...!!!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I bought cake, pastries, and other eatables from this bakery. The cake packet had no manufacturing date or expiry/use-by date, and when I asked, the staff said they do not mention dates on all products and that the cake stays fresh for 3 days. But the same day I noticed a sticky/gloopy texture, and by the next morning the cake had visible fungus/mould. Also, the pastries I bought were not up to the mark in terms of quality.

This is a serious food safety concern. As per FSSAI labelling requirements, packaged food should carry proper date details, especially expiry/use-by information. I hope the bakery takes this seriously and ensures better freshness, hygiene, product quality, and proper date labelling going forward.
